title: ATTACK 1 -- OPEN-STRONG: pre-registration, written BEFORE any new measurement
written_at: before the first GPU forward pass of this attack
claim_under_test: The open-text arm's escalation target has only ever been ONE greedy Lingshu-32B pass. always-32B-direct is therefore the cheapest possible use of the 32B. Does the SAME frozen trained verifier that converts the 7B's best-of-8 (greedy 0.4495 -> selected 0.4853) also convert a 32B best-of-N pool, and by enough to move the 8-cell macro past always-32B-direct = 0.6567?

target.primary_endpoint: macro accuracy over 8 reporting cells (Variant B, MMMU excluded, 1/8 each) of the best PRE-REGISTERED policy, vs always-32B-direct = 0.6567, paired item-level bootstrap nboot=10000, seed 20260810
target.bar: macro delta >= +0.0029 with 95% CI excluding zero
secondary: delta = A1-selected minus A0 (=always-32B-direct) per open cell, with CI
oracle@N and sel_eff of the 32B pool under the frozen disjoint verifier
cost in three currencies, each labelled: FLOP-eq (as-charged AND with the prefill-sharing assumption stated), measured wall-clock latency (parallel and sequential), measured NVML energy
token audit: mean generated tokens per cell per arm

N1.what: reproduce the frozen open-text metric from src/training_methods/genframe_data.py on the clean disjoint dumps

N2.what: reproduce the 8-cell macro from _selector_rerun_parts/vec_disjoint.npz against cascade_selector_rerun_2026-08-05.json arm 'disjoint'

N3.what: IDENTITY CONTROL. Regenerate the 32B open-text arm at N=1, temperature 0, with MY OWN runner (src/cascade_methods/openstrong_gen.py), judge it with the SAME judge, and reproduce always-32B-direct per-cell on the SAME item ids
N3.abort_if: per-cell abs deviation > 0.005 on ANY cell -- that would mean my prompt/decode path differs from the deployed one and the whole attack is invalid

N4.what: verifier transferability prior, offline, free: sel_eff of the LoRA verifier on NON-Lingshu7B generator pools
N4.DEVIATION_FROM_BRIEF: the brief said transfer_dump_{cell}_{lingshu7b,7b,iv3_8b}.json exist under ckpts/train/lora_verifier_disjoint/. VERIFIED ON DISK 2026-08-10: the DISJOINT verifier directory contains ONLY the lingshu7b dumps. The cross-generator dumps (7b = MedVLThinker-7B, iv3_8b = InternVL3-8B) exist ONLY under ckpts/train/lora_verifier_pooled4/, i.e. only for the CONTAMINATED verifier. N4 is therefore computed on pooled4 and is reported as a CONTAMINATED-VERIFIER PRIOR, not as a clean measurement.
N4.abort_if: nothing -- N4 is a prior, not a gate

arms.A0: Lingshu-32B, N=1, temperature 0, cap320 -- the always-32B-direct baseline regenerated by my runner (this IS the N3 control)
arms.A1: Lingshu-32B, N=8, temperature 0.7, cap320, vLLM n=8 (SHARED PREFILL), seed 0 -- oracle@8, majority-vote, and verifier-selected
arms.A2: the cost-tempered N=4 variant. DEFINED AS the first 4 slots of A1's 8-sample pool (an iid 4-draw), NOT an independent generation run. Labelled as a sub-pool everywhere.
arms.A3: Lingshu-7B best-of-8 + the same frozen disjoint verifier -- the incumbent cheap arm, from existing dumps
arms.A4: the deployed cascade with the escalation target swapped from A0 to A1's verifier-selected answer (keeps the 7B leg and the existing escalation gate)
arms.A5: FORMAT-AWARE ALLOCATION: all open text -> A1 verifier-selected, no 7B leg; the 5 MCQ cells keep the deployed accuracy-max arm unchanged

extra_arms_added_before_the_run_because_.A1_seeds: A1 is generated at >= 3 independent vLLM seeds (0, 1, 2) so the sampling-draw variance of the N=8 arm is MEASURED, not assumed. Reported as mean/sd/range over seeds plus the seed-averaged deployable number. A single seed is not a result (protocol rule 4).
extra_arms_added_before_the_run_because_.note: no training happens in this attack -- the verifier and the selector are FROZEN -- so 'seeds' here means generation-sampling seeds, which is the only stochastic component.

selector.which: ckpts/train/lora_verifier_disjoint (the CLEAN disjoint-trained LoRA verifier), scored under HF transformers
selector.never_vllm: vLLM 0.9.0.1 silently drops visual.* LoRA modules (0.775204 HF vs 0.702997 vLLM). All verifier scoring is HF.
selector.scoring_path: the pyes() path of src/training_methods/verifier_transfer_eval.py verbatim: SYS grader prompt, max_pixels 1280*28*28 (FULLRES), min_pixels 4*28*28, bfloat16, flash_attention_2, P(Yes)/(P(Yes)+P(No)) from the last-position logits
selector.pick_rule: argmax over slots with FIRST-INDEX tie-break (genframe_data.picks_from_scores), the frozen rule
selector.no_refit: the verifier is NOT retrained on 32B candidates in this session -- that would reopen the exhausted selection axis (see KILL below)

labels.currency: the SAME LLM judge as every published open-text cell: src/labeling/run_judge.py, MedVLThinker-32B text-only, Yes/No logit comparison
labels.rule: exact-match `oks` are written by the generator but are DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; never mix exact-match and judge currencies in one comparison

success_pre_committed.primary_win: macro delta vs always-32B-direct >= +0.0029 with 95% CI excluding zero, AND no single cell worse than always-32B-direct by more than 2x its own bootstrap SE, AND the policy was fixed on train-split/format information only (A5 and A1 involve NO fitting at all)
success_pre_committed.partial_still_reportable: delta >= +0.0077 measured on the open cells with CI excluding zero, even if the integrated macro CI includes zero

kill_pre_committed.K1: delta < +0.005 with CI including zero on >= 2 of 3 open cells => report: 'the strong leg has no best-of-N headroom on medical open-text VQA; always-32B-direct is a fair bar.' Write it up; it hardens the paper.
kill_pre_committed.K2: 32B pool sel_eff < 0.60 (the verifier does not transfer to 32B candidates) => report as a verifier-domain negative and STOP. Do not retrain the verifier on 32B candidates in this session.

baseline_honesty_obligation: A1's own accuracy IS always-32B-best-of-8. If it exceeds always-32B-direct it must be reported in the same table as a NEW, STRONGER, COSTLIER baseline, with its cost, and it must be stated plainly that a compute-matched reader should compare the method against A1. It must NOT be suppressed because it makes the target harder.

numerics_pins.ranking_convention: rank_avg (genframe_data.rank_avg) wherever ranks are used; rank_argsort is worth +0.008 here and is NOT used
numerics_pins.generation: vLLM 0.9.0.1, bfloat16, tp=1, gpu_memory_utilization 0.90, max_model_len 4096, max_tokens 64, cap320 (max_pixels 250880, min_pixels 3136), SamplingParams.seed set explicitly
numerics_pins.verifier: HF transformers, bfloat16, flash_attention_2, batch 1, fullres max_pixels 1003520

not_a_rediscovery_of: the ~20 exhausted selection approaches (COMPARATIVE_VERIFIER_2026-08-05.md): every one held the GENERATOR fixed at Lingshu-7B and varied the SELECTOR. This holds the selector fixed and changes the generator to the 32B.

verifier_n_scaling_2026-08-03.json (-0.0761 sel_eff per doubling): that scaled N inside the 7B's pool. A different generator has a different coverage curve and a different pool-purity curve; the decay constant is not transferable and is re-measured here.
crossfamily_verifier_sweep_2026-08-04.json: those are JUDGES (worse); this changes CANDIDATES.
bestofn_measure_batch8: a latency/energy measurement with no accuracy arm.
abstention in any form -- every path in every arm returns an answer (CRITICAL RULE 6).
